research.title: A Content Security Policy You Can Actually Ship on Next.js
research.whyTrending: Nonces, strict-dynamic, and why almost every Next.js CSP example on the internet is either unsafe-inline or broken in the App Router. The blog covers supply-chain and agent security heavily but has nothing on browser-side security headers.

content.finalTitle: The Next.js CSP Trade-Off: A Nonce Costs You Static Rendering
